import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        double x = sc.nextDouble();
        double y = sc.nextDouble();
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        
        final double q = x / y;
        double p = 0.0;
        double s = 1.0;
        
        for (double i = 1.0; i <= n; i += 1.0) {
            double candidate1 = Math.floor(q * i);
            double candidate2 = (double) (long) Math.ceil(q * i);
            double[] candidates = {candidate1, candidate2};
            
            for (int k = 0; k < 2; ++k) {
                double numerator = candidates[k];
                if (Math.abs(q - numerator / i) < Math.abs(q - p / s)) {
                    p = numerator;
                    s = i;
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println((long)p + "/" + (long)s);
    }
}
